name: PeekYou
tip: Easiest: tap SEND EMAIL REQUEST. To use their form instead, first search your name on peekyou.com, open your profile and copy its link. The form wants that link, the number at the end of it, your name, email, city and state. Then tap the link they email you. Removal can take up to 15 days. If nothing there is you, tap NOT LISTED.

name: ClustrMaps
tip: Search your name, filter by your state and open your record with View Details. At the bottom tap Remove My Info, which fills in the record's link. Fill in what it asks, tick every item it lists and apply, then tap any link they email you. It can take up to two weeks. If nothing there is you, tap NOT LISTED.

name: LocateFamily
tip: Find your listing. Browsing by the first letter of your last name works better than the search box. If a trash can shows next to it, tap that and fill in the form. If not, note the number to the left of your name, open your listing and copy its link, then use the removal form linked at the bottom of the site with your details, that link and that number. Tap the link if they email you. If nothing there is you, tap NOT LISTED.

name: PeopleByName
tip: Enter your details the way your listing shows them, do the CAPTCHA and submit. They say it is gone within 24 hours. If nothing there is you, tap NOT LISTED.

name: Inforver
tip: Search your name, city and state, tap View Profile on yours, then CONTROL PROFILE at the bottom, which fills in the link. Enter your name and email, do the CAPTCHA and tap Submit Opt Out Request. Then tap the link they email you. It takes up to 48 hours. If nothing there is you, tap NOT LISTED.

name: Cubib
tip: Search your name, open each record that is you and tap Opt-Out on it. Fill in the form as the record shows, do the CAPTCHA and tap Proceed. Cubib often has more than one record per person, so repeat for each. It can take several days. If nothing there is you, tap NOT LISTED.

name: WeInform and TruthRecord
tip: One opt-out covers both sites. At the bottom of the page tap Do Not Sell My Info, search your name and state, and pick your record. Fill in the form and submit, then tap the link they email you. If nothing there is you, tap NOT LISTED.

name: DMAchoice (junk mail lists)
tip: Not free: $6 online, and it lasts 10 years. It stops catalogs, magazine offers, donation requests and store promotions from companies you have never bought from or given to. It does not stop political mail, mail to Current Resident, or mail from companies you deal with. Register, pick what to stop, then tap MARK AS DONE. To skip it, tap NOT LISTED.

name: Smart TV: stop it reporting what you watch
tip: Do this on the TV itself. Most smart TVs take pictures of the screen to work out what you watch, and use it for ads. Texas sued Samsung, LG, Sony, Hisense and TCL over this in December 2025. Samsung: Settings > All Settings > General & Privacy > Terms & Privacy, turn off Viewing Information Services. LG: Settings > All Settings > Support > Privacy & Terms > User Agreements, turn off Viewing Information. Sony: Settings > All Settings, below Privacy turn off Samba Interactive TV. Roku TV (TCL, Hisense and others): Settings > Privacy > Smart TV Experience, uncheck Use Info from TV Inputs. Fire TV: Settings > Preferences > Privacy Settings, turn off Collect App and Over-the-Air Usage Data. Vizio: Settings > All Settings > Admin & Privacy, turn off Viewing Data. Then tap MARK AS DONE. No smart TV? Tap NOT LISTED.

name: Samsung phone: Customization Service off
tip: Do this on your phone. Samsung's Customization Service can use your apps, contacts, call and text history, browsing and location to aim ads at you. Open Settings, tap the magnifier, type Customization and open Customization Service, then turn it off. That stops it, but does not erase what it already has. To erase that, ask for your data to be deleted in your Samsung account's privacy settings. Then tap MARK AS DONE. Not on a Samsung phone? Tap NOT LISTED.
